1432|e214cf62.name: Renato Gallina
1432|e214cf62.text: Hey, mister.  You look like a $C with discerning tastes in wine.  I have a favor to ask, and I think I can make you an offer you can't refuse...forget about it!

2198|6c0228ac.name: Crier Goodman
2198|6c0228ac.text: Your legacy precedes you, $c. If you wish, I can allow you to rewrite that legacy into something new.

2198|dc8290dc.name: Crier Goodman
2198|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

246848|59873409.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|59873409.text: What is your curiosity looking for?

246848|aa74f3e4.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|aa74f3e4.text: Is there something I can help you with?

2543|912d8d1d.name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
2543|912d8d1d.text:
As a member of the High Order of shen'dorei, you are most welcome here in our city, $c. 

Your leader, Elaadrin Evengale and I have had quite the correspondence these recent months. I feel that the Kirin Tor and the High Order are cut from the same cloth, always in search of answers to the greater mysteries of the world. Now more than ever, seeking said answers is vital to all of our survival.

Just as you have experienced an interruption in your way of life on Zephras, the flow of magic on Azeroth has been chaotic as well. Disturbed, somehow... as if a rock has been dropped into still water, causing ripples to surge across the surface.

Ah, but talk of such troubles can wait for another time. For now, welcome to Azeroth.

275269|8059976c.name: High Order Dockmaster
275269|8059976c.text: The skycutter that arrives here will take you right to Dalaran City.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

32287|1d779665.name: Archmage Alvareaux
32287|1d779665.text:
Greetings, I am Archmage Alvereaux and I manage supply and logistics for the Kirin Tor.

Unfortunately, we have relatively few useful items available for disbursement to our friends and allies at present.

I suggest checking back often, as available stock may change from time to time.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

926|2583dfa7.name: Bromos Grummner
926|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

3107-progress.name: Bromos Grummner
3107-progress.text:
So, you've made it! And not a second too soon. There's much to be done in Coldridge Valley and beyond. I'm gonna need your help as much as you're gonna need mine!

You're a Knight of the Silver Hand now, be ready to play the part.
3107-progress.title: Consecrated Rune
